entries.name: Alistair of the Marshkeepers
entries.look: Darian's steward, guide, and — by his own admission — a guide who needed reminding to lead. He inventories rooms, boosts his lord into ceilings, and stopped a rolling pin mid-swing on the hunch that the man under it was not the enemy. He was right. Alistair's filing is a study in corrective action. When the plan failed, he surveyed the break room. When his lord went for a killing blow on an unverified target, he grabbed the arm. entries.name: Lord Darian Marsh of the Dark Shores
entries.look: A lord of the Dark Shores who fell out of the sky onto the Nintendo Mania pilot set with his steward and has spent two filings learning the studio's grammar: the exits lie, the applause is recorded, and the building stops when you tell it CUT. Pressed the button, took the rolling pin, ordered the V formation, crawled for the fire alarm, and hid in the alcove to watch the Director pass. Darian arrived wanting proof of the journey and a way home to his province, and got a course in television instead.
